gloss: any place becomes home once you live there

definitions.gloss: any place becomes home once you live there
definitions.explanation: Literally 'if you live there, it is the capital.' However unpromising a place seems at first, one grows to love it after living there.

examples.english: You'll love it once you live there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{住|す}めば{都|みやこ}だった。
examples.english: At first I was nervous about country life, but it soon felt like home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦アパート→アパート：01012_apaato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{住|す}めば{都|みやこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧⟦{気|き}に{入|い}っている→気に入る：02047_kiniiru⟧。
examples.english: Even a cramped apartment grows on you; now I really like mine.

notes:
⟦{都|みやこ}→都：03747_miyako⟧ is the capital, standing for the most desirable place to live.

USAGE:
Often said to reassure someone moving somewhere new, or looking back on a move that turned out well. It describes getting used to a place, not the place being good in itself.
